repo.ISSUE.md: label_samples gives me the lookup, but `lines` is always empty. I expected one line per sample.

fix.code:
def label_samples(names, samples):
    """Return (lookup, lines): a name -> dose dict and one 'name: dose' line per sample."""
    pairs = list(zip(names, (x.dose for x in samples)))
    lookup = dict(pairs)
    lines = ["%s: %s" % (name, value) for name, value in pairs]
    return lookup, lines
